study type: cohort study (comparison of two existing cohorts)
exposure: location of birth (Reunion Island vs. mainland France)
outcome: severe neurological injury (periventricular leukomalacia or grade III-IV intraventricular haemorrhages)
cohort: NICU-admitted very preterm infants born between 24 and 31 weeks of gestation from Reunion Island (OGP cohort, 2008-2013) and mainland France (EPIPAGE-2 cohort, 2011).
finding: Very preterm infants born in Reunion Island have a higher risk for death or severe morbidity compared with those born in mainland France, even after adjusting for gestational age, gender, and multiple perinatal factors.
